notes:
Improved Satin, Run and underlay generation in StitchFits and its integrated Digitizing Lab.

- Satin uses the same planner in both engine modes, with better start/end preservation and routing around holes.
- Closed Satin gains width-based Auto Spacing, thread-spacing controls, turning Zigzag, Center Run and Double Zigzag support.
- Auto Spacing works with Program Split and Flexi Split patterns, including Raised Satin. Curved clipped caps regenerate more reliably.
- Fewer tiny routing stitches near compensated edges, with checks for cutouts and later stitch coverage.
- Improved Feather Edge and Hand Stitch on compensated and guided Satin.
- Run improvements cover minimum stitch length, curved and closed paths, decorative styles, markers, resizing and export.
- Improved machine-file travel handling and VP3 conversion.

Satin parity work continues. Physical stitch-out testing is not included in this release's verification.
